scripts.check:syntax: node --check assets/theme.js && node --check assets/media-gallery.js && node --check assets/gift-card.js && node --check docs/app.js && node --check docs/content.js
scripts.package:download: shopify theme package --path . && python3 scripts/package-download.py && npm run validate
